name: ISO/IEC 27001
description: Information security management system requirements with Annex A control themes for managing information security risk.

requirements.title: Organizational Controls
requirements.description: Governance, policies, roles, asset responsibilities, supplier relationships, incident management, and continuity controls.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the ISMS scope, approved policies, assigned responsibilities, risk treatment, supplier decisions, and evidence the processes operate.

requirements.title: People Controls
requirements.description: Screening, terms, awareness, disciplinary, remote work, and event reporting controls for personnel.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review approved personnel procedures and representative onboarding, training, remote work, and event reporting records.

requirements.title: Physical Controls
requirements.description: Physical entry, monitoring, environmental protection, equipment security, media, and clear desk controls.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review physical security policy, access and visitor records, facility tests, equipment protection, and media disposal evidence.

requirements.title: Technological Controls
requirements.description: Endpoint, access, authentication, vulnerability, configuration, logging, monitoring, backup, and secure development controls.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use Splunk tracking and technical evidence to show current coverage, exceptions, detection, vulnerability, backup, and change status.
